_doc: Review-only Tavily source discovery. This file controls a small, capped search sweep for first-party evidence. Results are candidates, never published facts. Most queries are host-allowlisted. The two unresolved-source queries are deliberately marked openDiscovery and still pass through the global blocklist.

profiles.label: Provider smoke check
profiles.purpose: Make exactly one basic, official-domain search to verify Tavily connectivity, response parsing, and source filtering without starting a broader discovery run.

queries.text: Frederick Maryland city service notice road closure parking transit {month} {year}

profiles.label: Official civic and travel changes
profiles.purpose: Find first-party notices that may change a user's plan. A candidate still requires source verification before Radius can label it current.

queries.text: Frederick Maryland city road closure detour parking transit service interruption public notice {month} {year}
Frederick County Maryland service alert transit schedule park closure public notice {month} {year}
Frederick County Maryland road closure traffic detour construction commuter bus MARC alert {month} {year}

profiles.label: New and changed events
profiles.purpose: Surface newly posted or changed events from local publishers without treating every indexed page as a recommendation.

queries.text: Frederick Maryland new event schedule cancellation postponement venue lineup performer band replacement change {month} {year}
Frederick Maryland performance live music community event schedule {month} {year}

profiles.label: Menus, reservations, and accessibility
profiles.purpose: Find exact first-party utility pages for high-intent place questions. The scout records links only; it does not copy menus or infer accessibility.

queries.text: Frederick Maryland menu reservations accessibility parking Cafe Nola JoJo's Hootch and Banter Wine Kitchen
Frederick Maryland Weinberg Center New Spire accessibility seating parking tickets

profiles.label: Food-truck schedules
profiles.purpose: Find dated schedule or location pages on vendor-owned sites. A page must contain a real date and place before it can support a live beacon.

queries.text: Frederick Maryland food truck schedule location this week Blendabowl Gravel and Grind Grilled Cheese Please
Frederick Maryland food truck schedule location this week Blues BBQ In10se BBQ M and L Ragin Cajun Whistle Punk
Frederick Maryland food trucks mobile vendors new closed directory {year}

profiles.label: Unresolved first-party sources
profiles.purpose: Recover a likely first-party source for known gaps. Open discovery is explicit and all results remain review-only.

queries.text: "The Derby" "New Market" Maryland official live music events schedule
"Bub-B-Que" Frederick Maryland official website schedule catering
reviewFor: a public schedule or booking page
